hint_honey: A thick, dense liquid. Mixes with water.
hint_wood: Light and absorbent. Weakens when wet.
hint_glass: Hard and brittle. Shatters under strong impacts.
hint_brush: Paint water, or dye existing liquid.
hint_touch: Touch solids. Can toggle anchored state.
hint_heat: Add or remove heat under the brush. Negative power cools.
hint_pressurize: Add air under the brush to raise gas pressure.
hint_depressurize: Remove air under the brush to lower gas pressure.
hint_hydrogen: A light flammable gas. Reacts with oxygen when sufficiently heated.
hint_oxygen: An oxidizing gas. Supports reactions with fuels such as hydrogen and carbon.
hint_carbon: Dense brittle graphite-like solid. Burns at a hot surface if explicit oxygen is present. Ambient air is not oxygen.
hint_carbon_dioxide: A heavy colorless gas. Shown with a faint identification tint. Product of carbon burning in oxygen.
view_help_chnk: Shows which parts of the world are currently active.
view_help_fill: Shows how much liquid is inside each cell.
view_help_ldiv: Shows where liquid is locally compressing or spreading.
view_help_temp: Shows temperature. Blue is colder; yellow and red are hotter.
view_help_rgdn: Shows which cells belong to rigid bodies.
view_help_rgdo: Draws rigid-body debug information over the current view.
view_help_mois: Shows absorbed moisture in rigid materials. Dry absorbent pixels are dark; saturated pixels are cyan. Non-absorbent solids stay gray.
view_help_gasa: How much gas is in each cell. Vacuum is dark. More gas reads brighter. Color follows the dominant gas identity.
prop_solids_note: Anchored solids stay fixed. Sleeping solids wake when disturbed. Powder paints loose grains instead of one body.
prop_gases_note: Injects into existing air. Ambient air is not oxygen. Mix hydrogen with oxygen, or carbon with oxygen, then heat past ignition.
prop_dye_note: Dye tints liquid only. Painting dye into empty air or solid does nothing.
prop_tool_window_hint: Controls are in the floating tool window.
tip_tw_title: Drag the header to move this window.
tip_tw_close: Close this window. The selected tool stays active.
tip_tw_brush_size: Changes the radius of this tool's brush.
tip_tw_solids: Allow this tool to affect rigid solids.
tip_tw_liquids: Allow this tool to affect liquids.
tip_tw_gases: Allow this tool to affect gases.
tip_tw_strict_delete: Deletes the entire rigid body if any part of it is touched.
tip_tw_brush_shape: Changes the area affected by the tool.
tip_tw_grab_strength: How firmly grabbed bodies follow the cursor.
tip_tw_group_grab: Grab multiple rigid bodies within the group radius.
tip_tw_group_grab_radius: Maximum distance used when selecting bodies for Group Grab.
tip_tw_phantom_grab: Temporarily disables collisions for grabbed rigid bodies.
tip_tw_color_mode: Paints compatible matter instead of placing new material.
tip_tw_dye_color: Color used while Color Mode is on.
tip_tw_group_touch: Applies enabled touch actions to multiple nearby rigid bodies.
tip_tw_group_touch_radius: Maximum distance used when selecting bodies for Group Touch.
tip_tw_toggle_anchor: Toggles the anchored state of touched rigid bodies.
tip_tw_heat_power: Adds or removes heat under the brush. Negative values cool.
tip_step: Advance one simulation step while paused.
tip_slosh: Give the liquid a sideways push.
tip_walled: Close the grid edges so they act as walls instead of a void.
tip_glow: Adds a soft glow around liquids.
tip_outlines: Draw outlines around liquids and solids.
tip_style_realistic: Shows richer depth, flow, and material detail.
tip_style_alpha: Flat colors with opacity based on amount.
tip_style_legacy: Classic PIPACE shading with depth, bright surfaces, motion, and noise.
tip_noise: Adjusts texture variation in noise-based appearance styles.
tip_mat_wood: Use wood for newly drawn solids.
tip_mat_stone: Use stone for newly drawn solids.
tip_mat_glass: Use glass for newly drawn solids.
tip_mat_metal: Use metal for newly drawn solids.
tip_vorticity: Adds extra swirl to flowing liquid.
tip_advection: Changes how liquid velocity is carried through the flow.
tip_residual: Merge tiny leftover amounts of liquid into nearby cells.
tip_quality_low: Lower simulation cost for slower computers. Does not change simulation rate or world appearance.
tip_quality_high: Higher simulation accuracy at a greater CPU cost.
tip_quality_auto: Adjust quality automatically to maintain performance.
tip_quality_custom: Choose Performance, Balanced, or Accurate per subsystem.
tip_thermal_off: Disable heat transfer without resetting temperatures.
tip_limiter: Controls how strongly liquid transfer is limited for stability.
tip_gas_half: Update gas every other physics tick.
tip_hz_20: Run physics at 20 updates per second.
tip_hz_30: Run physics at 30 updates per second.
tip_threads_auto: Choose the simulation thread count automatically.
tip_threads: Set the number of simulation worker threads.
tip_pressure: Set the maximum liquid pressure-solver iterations.
tip_settings: Open the settings window. Drag the title bar to move it. Esc closes it.
tip_gravity: Turn rigid-body gravity on or off. Does not change liquid gravity.
tip_vort_str: How strong vorticity confinement is when that toggle is on.
tip_catch_up: Extra physics ticks allowed if a frame runs long. Lower is kinder to slow CPUs.
tip_heat_every: Run the thermal conduction pass every N physics ticks. Higher is cheaper.
tip_anchored: New solids stay fixed in place.
tip_sleeping: New solids begin asleep and wake when disturbed.
tip_powder: Paint loose grains instead of one connected solid.
tip_grain: Width of each powder grain in pixels.
tip_cat_tools: Tools for editing and interacting with the world.
tip_cat_solids: Solid materials available to place. Carbon burns only with painted oxygen at a hot surface.
tip_cat_gases: Paintable gases. Hydrogen, oxygen, and carbon dioxide mix with air. Ambient air is not oxygen. Heat a hydrogen-oxygen mixture past ignition to form water vapor, or a hot carbon-oxygen surface to form CO2.
